title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre - Stanford University on 1983-08-21
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC/24
source: (FOB) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/FujiMetal Tape/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Generally good, treble‑heavy recording of a strong show that opens with a standout Cassidy performance.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the nearly perfect performance, especially noting the powerful opening with "Cassidy" and the overall improvement as the set progresses. The audio is described as treble‑heavy and a bit rough at the start, but still enjoyable at louder volumes. Sentiment is mixed because one reviewer gave a zero rating despite no specific musical complaint.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is praised by most reviewers (average ~4‑5 stars) while recording quality receives mixed comments (treble‑heavy, rough start), leading to a weighted rating around 3.9.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Treble‑heavy audio; starts rough but becomes clearer. No explicit mention of soundboard or audience source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Opens with Cassidy, which reviewers feel sets a positive tone; early part described as rough but improves noticeably through the set.
